data.name: Eithne
data.long_meaning: In Irish mythology, Eithne was the goddess of the earth and fertility. Her name is possibly derived from the Greek 'Aineia' or 'Eirene', meaning 'peace'. In Christian tradition, Eithne is mentioned in the 'Life of St. Patrick' as the mother of the Irish chieftain Dagda.
